initContainers.name: desk-ready

command:
set -u
log() { echo "persona-gate: $*"; }
cutoff="${GATE_CUTOFF_HHMM:-0400}"
case "$cutoff" in [0-2][0-9][0-5][0-9]) ;; *) log "bad GATE_CUTOFF_HHMM, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1;; esac
self="${GATE_SELF_JOB:-}"
[ -n "$self" ] || { log "own job-name label missing, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
[ -f /usr/share/zoneinfo/Europe/Amsterdam ] || { log "no tzdata for Europe/Amsterdam, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
export TZ=Europe/Amsterdam
# Explicit kubeconfig: with --request-timeout kubectl ignores in-cluster config (falls back to localhost).
sa=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
[ -n "${KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST:-}" ] && [ -n "${KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT:-}" ] && [ -r "$sa/token" ] && [ -r "$sa/ca.crt" ] \
  || { log "no API endpoint or token, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
export KUBECONFIG="$HOME/kubeconfig"
printf '%s\n' 'apiVersion: v1' 'kind: Config' 'current-context: gate' \
  "clusters: [{name: in, cluster: {server: \"https://$KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST:$KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT\", certificate-authority: $sa/ca.crt}}]" \
  "users: [{name: gate, user: {tokenFile: $sa/token}}]" \
  'contexts: [{name: gate, context: {cluster: in, user: gate, namespace: passkey-point-e2e}}]' > "$KUBECONFIG" \
  || { log "cannot write kubeconfig, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
tmpl='{{range .items}}{{.metadata.name}}|{{with .spec.template.metadata.labels}}{{index . "app.kubernetes.io/name"}}{{end}}|{{with .metadata.labels}}{{index . "app.kubernetes.io/name"}}{{end}}|{{.status.active}}|{{.status.terminating}}|{{range .status.conditions}}{{if eq .status "True"}}{{.type}},{{end}}{{end}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}'
while :; do
  now="$(date +%H%M)" && zone="$(date +%Z)" || { log "date failed, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
  case "$zone" in CET|CEST) ;; *) log "zone '$zone' is not CET/CEST, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1;; esac
  case "$now" in [0-2][0-9][0-5][0-9]) ;; *) log "bad local time, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1;; esac
  if [ "$now" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then log "local $now $zone >= cutoff $cutoff, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; fi
  out="$(kubectl -n passkey-point-e2e get jobs.batch --request-timeout=10s -o go-template="$tmpl")" \
    || { log "API error, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
  blocking=""; seen=0
  while IFS='|' read -r name tl ml active term conds; do
    [ -n "$name" ] || continue
    if [ "$name" = "$self" ]; then seen=1; continue; fi
    rel=0
    for l in "$tl" "$ml"; do case "$l" in passkey-point-e2e|passkey-point-e2e-dotnet) rel=1;; esac; done
    [ "$rel" = 1 ] || continue
    [ "$active" = "<no value>" ] && active=0
    fin=0
    case ",$conds" in *,Complete,*|*,Failed,*) fin=1;; esac
    [ "$fin" = 1 ] && [ "$active" = 0 ] && [ "$term" = 0 ] && continue
    blocking="$blocking $name(active=$active,terminating=$term,conditions=$conds)"
  done <<EOF
$out
EOF
  [ "$seen" = 1 ] || { log "own Job $self not in the list, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
  if [ -z "$blocking" ]; then
    now="$(date +%H%M)" || { log "date failed, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; }
    case "$now" in [0-2][0-9][0-5][0-9]) ;; *) log "bad local time, fail closed, no tenant step taken"; exit 1;; esac
    if [ "$now" -ge "$cutoff" ]; then log "local $now $zone >= cutoff $cutoff after the check, no tenant step taken"; exit 1; fi
    log "PASS at $now $zone: no other e2e Job active, cutoff $cutoff"; exit 0
  fi
  log "waiting at $now $zone:$blocking"
  sleep 15
done
initContainers.name: persona-gate
